title: Ideals in Arbitrary Three-Dimensional Algebras
summary: In this paper, we study arbitrary (not necessarily associative) 3-dimensional algebras. Such an algebra A is determined by a basis and the corresponding multiplication table, which is specified by 27 structure constants. We describe all ideals of A, providing an explicit characterization of both 1-dimensional and 2-dimensional ideals. Moreover, we classify 2-dimensional ideals into 4 distinct types.
